name: Alert humans about due Airtable actions without duplicate notifications

parameters.filterByFormula: AND({Next Action At} != BLANK(), {Next Action At} <= NOW(), NOT(OR({Status}='Done',{Status}='Closed',{Status}='Rejected',{Status}='Suppressed')))

parameters.content:
## 1. Connect Airtable
Use a table with **Status**, **Next Action**, and **Next Action At**. **Company**, **Name**, or **Title** can be used as the display label. Replace the placeholder Base and Table IDs, then connect your Airtable credential.

## 2. Why the Code node exists
The workflow stores an idempotency key in workflow static data. The same record + due time + next action is alerted only once, even if the schedule keeps running.

## 3. Human-in-the-loop by default
Connect Gmail and replace **you@example.com**. This workflow only alerts an internal human. It does **not** automatically send follow-ups to customers, candidates, or employees.

## CLEAR MERIT Internal / Working Demo
This public template is adapted from CLEAR MERIT's own operations workflows. It is **internal operating proof, not an external client case study**. Test one due item, one retry, and one manual rerun before activation.
